description: This file implements the SettingsScreen widget for a Flutter application. It provides a user interface for adjusting reader font size, theme mode, and backend URL override, interacting with a SettingsProvider for state management.

classes.name: SettingsScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the settings screen where users can modify font size, theme, and backend URL override.

classes.name: _SettingsScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the user interactions and UI state for the SettingsScreen widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, setting up the backend URL override text from SettingsProvider.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, specifically disposing of the TextEditingController.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the settings screen, including sliders, segmented buttons, and text fields for different settings.
